paragraphs.text: Herigast is a legendary Eldrazi Dragon from an unknown plane.

Herigast is a character that was introduced in Modern Horizons 3 . Since it is a dragon that has warped into an Eldrazi, rather than a pure Eldrazi brood, it seems likely that it is one of countless beings caught under the influence of Emrakul on Innistrad during the events of Eldritch Moon .
